title: coland interop: directory is an Arkret object, not the -06/-07 §5.1 operation→URI map
description:
Side: coland. Live: https://coland.reviewcommit.com/.well-known/mimi-protocol-directory (coland 76ef1bf5ea07).

coland serves an Arkret object (schema ak.schema.mimi_interop.v1: service_id, service_kind, supported_profiles, mimi{protocol_draft, base_url, provider_id, endpoints[{endpoint_id, relative_path}], features, mls_cipher_suites, content_profiles, room_policy_components}, detached-JWS proof). protocol-06 and -07 §5.1 define a flat JSON map from operation name to absolute URI template: keyMaterial, update, notify, submitMessage, groupInfo, requestConsent, updateConsent, identifierQuery, reportAbuse, proxyDownload.
- None of the -06/-07 keys are present. endpoint_ids are snake_case (key_material, room_update, submit_message, identifier_query, consent, notify), and the paths are relative /_arkret/open/mimi/... with {strand_id} in place of {roomId}. keyMaterial has no {targetUser}, and identifierQuery has no {domain}.
- There are no groupInfo, reportAbuse or updateConsent entries. proxy_download is listed in arkret-spec mimi-interop.md §3 features, and the route exists (POST /_arkret/open/mimi/proxy-download), but it is missing from the directory's endpoints and features.
- Result: mimid's PeerClient (tools/interop/seed mimid-seed-probe, worktree seed-users e51e3da) fails at discovery with "the peer does not offer keyMaterial".
Code: coland crates/http/src/routing/interop/mimi/payload.rs mimi_provider_directory_value / mimi_provider_directory_endpoints.
